description:
Hushfeed v0.64.0 has 98 patches for global TikTok 47.0.3 and 47.1.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically). It's a fix release with no new patches.

Hidden right-column buttons now stay hidden on videos opened from a creator's profile, a hashtag or a sound. Hide TikTok Shop also hides a LIVE that's selling. Screen time keeps counting after you come back from messages or settings, and a muted feed no longer pauses another app's music when you open the comments.

Downloads, the settings search, Undo last restore, caption languages and diagnostic redaction get fixes too, and Clear all on the Inbox's suggested accounts works on 47.1.3. See the changelog for the full list.

Validation: 2335 runtime tests passed and 454 patch tests passed locally. Both Android lint checks passed. All 98 patches applied to both supported APKs with resource and manifest checks. The attached release receipt identifies the exact source and bundle. The hidden-button, settings search and Inbox fixes were checked on a physical phone running TikTok 47.0.3.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source to update. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
